feature_descriptions.oldbalanceOrg: Origin account initial balance before transaction
feature_descriptions.newbalanceOrig: Origin account balance after transaction (recalculated ledger)
feature_descriptions.oldbalanceDest: Destination account initial balance before transaction
feature_descriptions.newbalanceDest: Destination account balance after transaction (recalculated ledger)
feature_descriptions.account_depletion_ratio: Ratio of transaction amount to origin balance (amount / oldbalanceOrg, capped at 5.0)
feature_descriptions.dest_surge_ratio: Ratio of transaction amount to post-transaction destination balance
feature_descriptions.is_zero_oldbalance_orig: Indicator (1/0) whether origin account started with zero balance
feature_descriptions.is_zero_oldbalance_dest: Indicator (1/0) whether destination account started with zero balance
